terms.def: The complete set of genetic information in an organism — all its DNA

terms.def: Medical treatment tailored to an individual's specific genetic make-up

terms.def: The process of making an mRNA copy of a gene from the DNA template — occurs in the nucleus

terms.def: Messenger RNA — a single-stranded molecule that carries the genetic code from nucleus to ribosome

terms.def: The combination of alleles an organism carries for a particular gene

terms.def: Change in the inherited characteristics of a population over successive generations

terms.def: An inherited feature that makes an organism better suited to its environment

terms.def: How common a particular allele is in a population — natural selection changes allele frequencies over time
terms.lessonName: Evolution — natural selection and adaptation

terms.def: The collection of fossils showing how life has changed over geological time — key evidence for evolution
terms.lessonName: Evolution — natural selection and adaptation

terms.def: A group of organisms that can interbreed with each other to produce fertile offspring

terms.lessonName: Speciation — how new species form

terms.def: All the alleles of all the genes in a population at a given time

terms.lessonName: Genetic engineering and selective breeding

terms.def: The range of different alleles within a population — essential for adaptability and long-term survival

terms.def: Breeding between closely related individuals, increasing the risk of offspring inheriting two copies of harmful recessive alleles

terms.def: A facility that stores seeds from diverse plant varieties to preserve genetic diversity for future use

terms.def: Enzymes that cut DNA at specific sequences, used to isolate a desired gene

terms.lessonName: Genetic engineering and selective breeding

terms.def: Genetically modified organism — one that has had its genome altered by genetic engineering
terms.lessonName: Genetic engineering and selective breeding

terms.lessonName: Genetic engineering and selective breeding

terms.def: Living factors in an environment (e.g. food availability, predators, competitors, pathogens)

terms.def: The variety of different species living in an ecosystem — higher biodiversity = more stable ecosystem

terms.def: A feeding level in a food chain — producers are at trophic level 1, primary consumers at level 2, etc.
terms.lessonName: Food chains and food webs — energy transfer

terms.def: An organism (bacterium or fungus) that breaks down dead organic matter, releasing minerals back into the ecosystem

terms.def: The percentage of energy from one trophic level that is passed on to the next — typically around 10%

terms.lessonName: Biodiversity and conservation

terms.lessonName: Biodiversity and conservation

terms.lessonName: Biodiversity and conservation
